brand_notes.fabric: brands.json's brand-level fabric string is 'X-Pac (visible X ripstop grid)'. This holds up well for the Zeitgeist Pack, especially in the tie-dye 'Luminary' colorway where the diagonal X-Pac diamond stitch grid is clearly visible under the dye. Most of the coyote-tan products (Catalyst, Bandito, Gemini, Hold Fast, Giddy Up, Gibby, Sidekick, Kestrel, Sugarloaf, Moxie) are a plain coated ripstop/cordura-weight canvas with NO visible X-Pac grid in these photos - flat, matte, no diamond stitch pattern discernible even at close range. Capstone ships in black only and is likewise a plain matte canvas. So the X-Pac grid is real but is only clearly evidenced on one product (Zeitgeist); treat the rest as an unconfirmed-but-plausible coated ripstop rather than assuming the visible-grid X-Pac look catalogue-wide.
brand_notes.assetMismatch: One image in each of the zeitgeist/catalyst/bandito/gemini folders (the '-3' file for zeitgeist, catalyst, and gemini; '-2' for bandito) is a generic lifestyle photo of a pink 'Pine' demo gravel bike carrying a front+rear pair of small (~2-4L) tan flap bags that do not match that product's own size or silhouette - almost certainly a shared 'shop the look' marketing image reused across several product folders rather than a photo of that specific SKU. Not used as sizing/geometry evidence for those products; the studio and on-bike close-up photos in the same folders were used instead.
brand_notes.gibbyGeminiSpecDuplication: The Gibby Stem Bag and Gemini Cargo Pack maker pages carry byte-for-byte identical Specs-tab text - 'Measurements: 5" w x 9.5" h x 3" d' and 'Weight: 3.5 oz' - despite being different products (a stem-mounted drawcord pouch vs. a fork-cage-mounted roll-top cylinder) at different capacities (1.75L vs 4L). This looks like a copied Shopify spec block on Swift's own site. Cross-checked by volume: for Gibby the box (12.7x24.1x7.6cm=2331cc=2.33L) against its own 1.75L capacity gives a plausible ratio of 1.33, so the figure is kept for Gibby with medium-high confidence. For Gemini the same box gives 2.33L against a stated 4L capacity (ratio 0.58, box smaller than capacity - not plausible for dims meant to represent the maximum fill), which is why Gemini's own record treats capacity_l as the unrolled/max figure and the box as the rolled/as-mounted size instead of trusting the ratio at face value. See dims_note on each product.
brand_notes.gearBagsRequireHardware: The Gemini Cargo Pack (fork-mounted) requires a third-party or Swift's own 'Widefoot Cargo Mount Cage' (triple-boss fork cage, sold separately, $36) - it does not strap to a bare fork leg. The Sugarloaf Basket Bag is a structured insert built to sit inside a front wire basket (shown in-photo inside a basket, and customers describe it as basket-shaped/PDW-basket-fit) - it is not a standalone handlebar bag. Both are flagged per-product below rather than left in the universal mounting pool.

products.name: Zeitgeist Pack
products.dims_raw: Maker Specs tab (read from page HTML - the rendered page hides this behind a client-side tab a plain fetch cannot see): 'Measurements: 19" w X 9" h X 7" d; Capacity: 12 Liters'. 19in=48.3cm, 9in=22.9cm, 7in=17.8cm.
products.dims_note: Single fixed figure, not a range - the outer shell is a rigid structured box (shares the 'Rigid Cross Brace' construction visible on the Catalyst Pack's diagram) so there is no unfurled/rolled distinction on this shell; only an internal drawcord liner rolls, and it does not change the external box size. w->len (bar-to-bar run), h->hgt, d->wid (front-to-back off the bars). Box 48.3x17.8x22.9=19684cc=19.7L against stated 12L, ratio 1.64 - normal headroom for a flap-over bag whose inner roll-top liner is not packed to the shell's full volume.

geometry.notes: Rigid structured shell, flat top and front flap. Opening the flap reveals a separate internal roll-top drawcord liner (black fabric, pink cord, plastic side-release buckle) nested inside the shell - the exterior flap is a fixed weatherproof cover, not the actual seal.

closure.hardware: internal storm-collar drawcord (pink cord, black side-release buckle) sealed beneath a fixed non-removable weatherproof flap; flap held down by 2 external compression straps

details.reflective: vertical white reflective stripe each side of the front flap
details.fabric: coated ripstop with a visible diagonal X-Pac diamond grid stitch (clearest in the Luminary tie-dye colorway) - matches brands.json's brand-level fabric string for this product specifically; see brand_notes.fabric for why that does not hold for the rest of the catalogue

mount.notes: Sits on top of and in front of the bar; two straps loop around the bar and buckle at the bag's front-bottom edge. At 22.9cm tall this is a large bar bag for a 56cm drop-bar gravel bike - check tyre/toe clearance on smaller frames. No steerer/fork stabiliser strap is visible in these photos (unlike the smaller Catalyst Pack, which has one).

products.name: Catalyst Pack
products.dims_raw: Maker Specs tab (page HTML): 'Measurements: 11"w x 7"h x 6"d; Capacity (in Liters): 7.5 Liters'. 11in=27.9cm, 7in=17.8cm, 6in=15.2cm.
products.dims_note: Single fixed figure. w->len, h->hgt, d->wid. Box 27.9x15.2x17.8=7551cc=7.55L against stated 7.5L, ratio 1.01 - the box is essentially the true packed size, consistent with a small rigid-shelled bar bag.

geometry.notes: Same rigid-shell family as the Zeitgeist but smaller and with a real top zip rather than an internal roll-top liner. Labelled diagram on the product page calls out a 'Rigid Cross Brace' battening the flap's leading edge and 'Coverlite Reinforcement' patches at the strap-buckle load points.

closure.hardware: single top-mounted YKK slider with a tan pull tab, protected by a fixed non-removable weatherproof flap secured by 2 buckle straps; a rigid cross-brace battens the flap's leading edge

details.fabric: coated matte ripstop canvas, no visible X-Pac grid in these photos - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Smaller bar bag than the Zeitgeist. A shock-cord 'Steer Tube Attachment Strap' hangs off the bottom-centre of the bag and cinches to the steerer/headset, which is what keeps this size from rotating or sagging forward - the Zeitgeist relies on strap tension alone and has no equivalent stabiliser in its photos.

products.name: Bandito Bicycle Bag
products.dims_raw: Maker Specs tab (page HTML): 'Measurements: 8.5"w X 5.5" diameter; Capacity: 3.2 Liters'. 8.5in=21.6cm, 5.5in=14cm.
products.dims_note: A true round cylinder - maker gives length and a single diameter figure, so wid and hgt are both set to that diameter. len=21.6 is the tube's own long axis, not a world direction (see mount.axes). Volume as a straight cylinder = pi*7^2*21.6=3327cc=3.33L against stated 3.2L, ratio 1.04 - consistent with a structured roll-top tube that is not further compressible along its length once rolled.

geometry.notes: Simple structured roll-top tube, same silhouette regardless of where it is mounted. Sold and photographed in three different positions: hanging below the stem/steerer, strapped along a fork leg, and lashed under the saddle rails.

closure.hardware: rolled 2 turns and clipped with a single black side-release buckle; small elastic pull-loop tab at the rolled lip

details.fabric: coated matte ripstop canvas, no visible X-Pac grid in these photos - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Marketed as a 'Handlebar and Saddle Bag' but the local photos most clearly show a fork-leg mount (single girth strap around the blade near the disc rotor). Genuinely multi-position - treat the fork-leg reading as the default, not the only valid one; slot given by the catalogue ('barroll') implies a bar-adjacent mount instead, so this should be sanity-checked against whichever mount the renderer actually targets.

products.name: Gemini Cargo Pack
products.dims_raw: Maker Specs tab (page HTML): 'Measurements: 5" w x 9.5" h x 3" d; Capacity: 4 Liters'. 5in=12.7cm, 9.5in=24.1cm, 3in=7.6cm.
products.dims_note: See brand_notes.gibbyGeminiSpecDuplication - this text is byte-identical to the Gibby Stem Bag's spec block, which is suspicious, but is kept because it is the only figure Swift publishes for this product. len=24.1 (the 9.5in figure) is the tube's long axis; wid=12.7 is the wider cross-section face, hgt=7.6 the flatter 'back panel' face that sits against the cargo cage. Box 24.1x12.7x7.6=2328cc=2.33L against a stated 4L capacity, ratio 0.58 (box smaller than capacity) - physically impossible if 4L were the packed size, so capacity_l is read as the maximum/unrolled fill and this box as the rolled, as-mounted size instead, per the customer description of it as a 'semi-rigid roll top dry bag' with an internal shape-holding insert.

geometry.notes: Semi-rigid roll-top tube with an internal plastic insert that holds its shape even underfilled (per customer reviews); one face is flattened ('ballistic grade fabric... where the bag comes into contact with the cage' per the maker) to sit flush against a cargo cage rather than a true round cylinder.

closure.hardware: roll-top with a side-release buckle clip

details.fabric: coated ripstop body with a reinforced ballistic-weight back panel where it contacts the cargo cage

mount.notes: Cannot mount to a bare fork leg - requires a third-party or Swift's own triple-boss 'Widefoot Cargo Mount Cage' (sold separately, $36) bolted to the fork first, then velcro-strapped to that cage. Assumes the host frame/fork has triple-boss mounts; see brand_notes.gearBagsRequireHardware.

products.name: Hold Fast Half Frame Bag
products.dims_raw: Maker Specs tab (page HTML): 'Measurements: 16.5"L X 3.75"H X 2.25"D; Capacity: 2.75L'. 16.5in=41.9cm, 3.75in=9.5cm, 2.25in=5.7cm.
products.dims_note: Box 41.9x5.7x9.5=2269cc=2.27L against stated 2.75L - box smaller than capacity is expected here because it is a right-triangle wedge (roughly half the bounding box), not a soft bag with headroom. Reads as internally consistent.

geometry.notes: Half-frame wedge mounted only along the top tube (does not reach the down tube or bottom bracket, unlike the full-triangle Giddy Up). Tall squared face at the head-tube end carrying the zip and logo patch, tapers in a straight run to a near-zero point at the seat tube.

closure.hardware: single YKK slider under a small fabric 'zipper garage' flap that shields the pull from the elements; tan pull cord

details.valve: hydration hose / cable port grommet at the nose end (per maker diagram)
details.fabric: coated matte ripstop canvas, no visible X-Pac grid in these photos - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Single-side half-frame bag strapped flush to one side of the main triangle, flat against the top tube and down tube; ships in one size per side, not a wraparound pair.

products.dims_raw: Maker Specs tab (page HTML): 'Measurements: 18.75"L X 4.25"H X 2.25"D; Capacity: 3.25L'. 18.75in=47.6cm, 4.25in=10.8cm, 2.25in=5.7cm.
products.dims_note: Box 47.6x5.7x10.8=2930cc=2.93L against stated 3.25L - same right-triangle-wedge headroom pattern as the Small, internally consistent.

products.name: Hold Fast Half Frame Bag
products.dims_raw: Maker Specs tab (page HTML): 'Measurements: 20.25"L X 5"W X 2.25"D; Capacity: 4L'. 20.25in=51.4cm, 5in=12.7cm, 2.25in=5.7cm. products.dims_note: Box 51.4x5.7x12.7=3721cc=3.72L against stated 4L, ratio 0.93 - slightly tighter than the Small/Medium but still a plausible wedge fraction, internally consistent.

products.name: Giddy Up Wedge Frame Bag
products.dims_raw: Maker Specs tab (page HTML): 'Dimensions Measurements: 12"w X 8.5"h X 2"d; Capacity: 3.3 Liters'. 12in=30.5cm, 8.5in=21.6cm, 2in=5.1cm.
products.dims_note: Box 30.5x5.1x21.6=3360cc=3.36L against stated 3.3L, ratio 1.02 - fills essentially its whole bounding box, consistent with a full-triangle wedge that occupies nearly the entire main triangle rather than just the top tube.

geometry.notes: Fills the entire main triangle - top tube, seat tube AND down tube - unlike the Hold Fast, which only runs along the top tube. Tall face at the head-tube/down-tube junction carrying the zip, tapering to a point near the seat cluster.

closure.hardware: single YKK slider under a fabric 'zipper garage' flap; tan pull cord, runs the full top-tube-facing edge

details.valve: hydration hose / cable port grommet at the nose end (per maker diagram)
details.fabric: coated matte ripstop canvas, no visible X-Pac grid in these photos - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Full-triangle frame bag, one side only. Requires velcro loop points along all three main-triangle tubes; will not fit frames with bottle-cage bosses or cable routing across the down tube face it covers.

products.name: Gibby Stem Bag
products.dims_raw: Maker Specs tab (page HTML): 'Measurements: 5" w x 9.5" h x 3" d; Capacity : 1.75 Liters'. 5in=12.7cm, 9.5in=24.1cm, 3in=7.6cm.
products.dims_note: See brand_notes.gibbyGeminiSpecDuplication - this exact text also appears on the Gemini Cargo Pack's page, which is suspicious, but for Gibby the volume checks out: box 24.1x12.7x7.6=2331cc=2.33L against a stated 1.75L capacity, ratio 1.33 - a normal fraction for a soft drawcord pouch. len=24.1 (9.5in) is the pouch's own vertical axis when hanging from the stem; wid/hgt are the oval cross-section's two faces. Kept at medium confidence given the duplication with Gemini's page text.

geometry.notes: Structured drawcord pouch, oval (not round) cross-section, single horizontal daisy-chain webbing band around the middle, drain hole in the base. Nearly identical construction to the smaller Sidekick Stem Pouch, just taller/wider - per a customer review it 'fits my quart hydro flask' (a 32oz wide-mouth bottle, ~22cm tall).

closure.hardware: single-handed cinch drawcord with a cord-lock and pull tab, black storm-collar top

details.fabric: coated matte ripstop canvas, no visible X-Pac grid in these photos - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Hangs vertically from a single horizontal girth strap cinched around the stem or bar area next to the head tube, opening upward. At 24.1cm tall, check clearance against the front tyre/mudguard on small frames with limited stem-to-tyre gap.

products.name: Sidekick Stem Pouch
products.dims_raw: Maker Specs tab (page HTML): 'Measurements: 7.5" h X 4" diameter; Capacity : 1 Liter'. 7.5in=19.1cm, 4in=10.2cm.
products.dims_note: True round cylinder - wid and hgt both set to the published diameter. len=19.1 is the pouch's own vertical axis. Volume as a straight cylinder = pi*5.1^2*19.1=1560cc=1.56L against stated 1L, ratio 1.56 - plausible headroom for a drawcord-top pouch that necks in above the widest point.

geometry.notes: Smaller, plainer sibling of the Gibby Stem Bag - same drawcord-top structured-body construction, single horizontal daisy webbing band, drain hole in the base, but round rather than oval in cross-section and noticeably shorter.

closure.hardware: single-handed cinch drawcord with a cord-lock and pull tab, black storm-collar top

details.fabric: coated matte ripstop canvas, no visible X-Pac grid in these photos - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Hangs vertically from a single horizontal girth strap cinched around the stem or bar area, opening upward. Small enough that tyre/toe clearance is not a concern on a 56cm gravel bike.

products.name: Kestrel Handlebar Bag
products.dims_raw: Maker Specs tab (page HTML): 'Measurements: 10" w x 5" h x 3" d; Capacity : 2.5 Liters'. 10in=25.4cm, 5in=12.7cm, 3in=7.6cm.
products.dims_note: Box 25.4x7.6x12.7=2452cc=2.45L against stated 2.5L, ratio 0.98 - fills essentially its whole bounding box, consistent with a small structured zip bag rather than a soft roll bag.

geometry.notes: Compact structured handlebar bag, boxy silhouette, no compression straps or external pockets visible beyond the front zip pocket.

closure.hardware: single YKK water-resistant slider with a leather-billet pull cord, full-length across the top

details.fabric: coated matte ripstop canvas, no visible X-Pac grid in these photos - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Mounted via 2 lash-point straps/clamps clipped directly to the bar (visible clamp hardware in the exploded-feature photo), sitting close against the stem-front. No steerer strap needed at this small size.

products.name: Capstone Handlebar Bag
products.dims_raw: Maker Specs tab (page HTML): 'Measurements: 10" w X 4" d X 6" h; Capacity: 4 Liters'. 10in=25.4cm, 4in=10.2cm, 6in=15.2cm.
products.dims_note: Box 25.4x10.2x15.2=3939cc=3.94L against stated 4L, ratio 0.98 - fills essentially its whole bounding box, matching the structured, non-roll construction visible in photos.

geometry.notes: Small randonneur-style structured bar bag, plain flat-top box with soft webbing carry handle sewn along the top seam (visible as the black band running the length of the lid).

closure.hardware: front flap, black webbing loop at centre-front (no visible zip)

details.fabric: coated matte ripstop canvas, black only - no visible X-Pac grid in these photos - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Sold out at time of review; only the Black colorway is offered. Mounts directly to the bar, similar footprint to the Kestrel but slightly taller and marketed as a compact 'more compact option than the Zeitgeist Pack' randonneur-style bag.

products.name: Olliepack Seat Bag
products.dims_raw: Maker Specs tab (page HTML): 'Measurements (with 3 rolls): 17" h X 5.5" d X 6"w; Capacity: 6 Liters'. 17in=43.2cm, 5.5in=14cm, 6in=15.2cm.
products.dims_note: Maker's figure is explicitly given already-rolled ('with 3 rolls'), not an unfurled figure, so there is no separate unfurled length to prefer - this IS the packed size the new dimension rule wants for hgt, and length/width along the saddle rails do not meaningfully change with roll count for a seat pack. 17in('h') maps to len (nose-to-tail along the rails), 5.5in('d') maps to hgt (the rolled tube's own height), 6in('w') maps to wid (across, at the saddle-mount end). Box 43.2x15.2x14=9192cc=9.19L against stated 6L, ratio 1.53 - normal wedge/tube headroom.

geometry.notes: Structured seat bag, black reinforced base/end-cap panel, tan body, no external pockets or daisy chains visible.

closure.hardware: roll-top secured by a single wide side-release buckle strap wrapping the rolled tail

details.fabric: coated matte ripstop canvas body with a contrast black reinforced base/end-cap panel - no visible X-Pac grid in these photos - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Nose clamped to the saddle rails and stabilised against the seatpost; tail rolls down and buckles. Only one published dimension set (already at 3 rolls) - if the renderer allows fewer/more rolls, treat 14cm as the practical minimum height, not a true unfurled maximum.

products.name: Sugarloaf Basket Bag
products.dims_raw: Maker Specs tab (page HTML): 'Measurements: 14" w x 7" h x 7" d; Capacity : 11 Liters'. 14in=35.6cm, 7in=17.8cm (both h and d).
products.dims_note: Box 35.6x17.8x17.8=11278cc=11.28L against stated 11L, ratio 1.03 - fills essentially its whole bounding box, matching a rigid structured insert that fits snugly into a basket.

geometry.notes: Rigid structured duffel-style insert (per customer reviews, holds its shape with an internal stiffener) sized to drop into a front wire basket, e.g. a PDW basket - photographed sitting inside exactly that kind of basket, not strapped directly to bars. Soft webbing carry handles on top let it double as a cross-body/shoulder bag when lifted out.

closure.hardware: top zip under the carry handles; 2 magnetic front snap flaps for the exterior pockets

details.reflective: small reflective panel at one end
details.fabric: coated matte ripstop canvas, no visible X-Pac grid in these photos - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Requires a front wire basket to mount - it is a structured insert sized to drop into one (shown fitted inside a wire basket in these photos), not a standalone handlebar bag with its own bar-mounting hardware. See brand_notes.gearBagsRequireHardware.

products.name: Moxie Top Tube Bag
products.dims_raw: Maker Specs tab (page HTML): 'Measurements: 4.25" h x 8.5" w x 2" d; Capacity : 0.6 Liters'. 4.25in=10.8cm, 8.5in=21.6cm, 2in=5.1cm.
products.dims_note: Box 21.6x5.1x10.8=1190cc=1.19L against stated 0.6L, ratio 1.98 - normal headroom for a small tapered top-tube pouch that narrows sharply toward the seat-tube end.

geometry.notes: Small rounded-wedge top-tube pouch, taller/wider at the head-tube end, tapering toward the seat tube. Curved perimeter zip along the top edge with a reflective-corded pull.

details.fabric: coated matte ripstop canvas, no visible X-Pac grid in these photos - see brand_notes.fabric
